niche_preference_profile: Prefers interfaces that feel visually intentional and well-structured: clear hierarchy, strong grouping, visible content, and obvious primary actions. They often respond positively to populated, information-rich screens, polished rounded components, and layouts that feel complete rather than empty. They also like expressive but controlled visual personality—such as distinctive avatars, selective color accents, and modern styling—so long as the screen remains organized and task legible.

criteria.description: Prefers screens with strong hierarchy, clear sectioning, layered emphasis, and well-grouped content rather than flat or weakly separated layouts.
Prefers populated, information-rich interfaces that use space purposefully and feel complete, rather than sparse or underfilled screens.
Prefers bold, clearly surfaced primary actions and explicit next-step controls rather than hidden, missing, or weakly emphasized actions.
Prefers crisp text contrast, clear focal points, and visually legible presentation over washed-out or low-energy contrast treatment.
Prefers interfaces that include human or distinctive identity markers—such as avatars, photos, names, and selective color variation—rather than impersonal or abstract presentation.
Prefers refined component styling such as rounded cards, pill-shaped controls, elevated surfaces, and tactile modular UI rather than plain or weakly defined components.
Prefers straightforward, consistent control systems and cleaner action areas with less friction, rather than mixed control types or unnecessarily complex interaction patterns.
